children: OpenAI's valuation may continue climbing ahead of its hotly-anticipated initial public offering. The ChatGPT maker has held early talks with investors about a new funding round that could value it at more than $1.2 trillion, WSJ reports, up from a valuation of $852 billion in March. The potential for fresh funding comes on the heels of the release of Astra, OpenAI's latest cutting-edge model which it described as the world's most intelligent and aligned model. It would also come ahead of the company's IPO that's now expected next year. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
